subject.title: fix(ui): show Swarm progress in Chat

question: Should active Swarm progress be relocated exclusively to Chat, with the Dashboard card removed for existing Control UI users?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but choosing between a Chat-only experience and preserving a Dashboard entry point is a user-facing product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve Chat-only relocation
options.body: Accept the updated docs and remove the Dashboard card so the chat composer remains the single active Swarm monitoring surface.

options.title: Preserve Dashboard visibility
options.body: Keep a compact Dashboard summary or navigation affordance if Dashboard remains a supported monitoring workflow for collector Swarms.

recommendation.title: Approve Chat-only relocation
recommendation.body: Accept the updated docs and remove the Dashboard card so the chat composer remains the single active Swarm monitoring surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed Swarm Control UI interaction change.
